parameters.content:
🔖 **How to switch SANDBOX ↔ PRODUCTION**
1) Disconnect **Config (W4) — SANDBOX** → **Validate & Normalize W4 Input**.
2) Connect **Config (W4) — PRODUCTION** → **Validate & Normalize W4 Input**.
3) Enable the PRODUCTION path and disable SANDBOX:
   • Enable **Lulu PRODUCTION: Get Token (Retry)** → **Extract Lulu Access Token (PRODUCTION)** → **Submit Lulu Print Job (PRODUCTION - BEARER, Retry)**.
   • Disable **Lulu SANDBOX: Get Token (Retry)** and **Submit Lulu Print Job (SANDBOX - BEARER, Retry)**.
   • Validation nodes read token from whichever Extract ran (no extra change needed).
4) (Optional) You can still use **Submit Lulu Print Job (PRODUCTION - BASIC)**, but Bearer is recommended.
The **Status Banner** shows env + submit path and retry counts.

• Make sure **CONFIG.defaults.podPackageId** is correct before submitting real jobs.
• Use *Execute previous nodes* so `$json.CONFIG` is populated when testing token nodes.
